answers.rationale: The requirement specifies 15 kV walk-through switchgear, which aligns with the CROWN-ARMV product description for arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear. This product is engineered to order and meets IEEE C37.20.2 and C37.20.7 standards, suitable for the specified voltage level.
This requirement pertains to compliance and exceptions, which are not product-specific. The bid manager should address this.
